description:
FILED s478 (Fable, 2026-09-08) from a gate run INSIDE the install-matrix container
(podman, localhost/pcl-install-base, ubuntu:24.04 + tools/install-matrix/deps.sh,
perl 5.38.2, SBCL 2.6.0) -- the image has no /etc/protocols (no `netbase`).

Pl/t/transpile-test-09.t row 12 "getproto*: /etc/protocols, exact match, both scalar
shapes": perl prints every line EMPTY (`1 list=`, `2 scalar=`, `7 bynum=`, ...) because
getprotobyname reads /etc/protocols and there is none; PCL prints `1 list=tcp TCP 6`,
`2 scalar=6`, `8 bynum-scalar=udp`, `9 first-line-wins=ip IP 0` -- a built-in table
answers where perl says undef.  The four count rows agree (0).

PRE-EXISTING (the s337 getprotobyname-via-/etc/protocols work; CI was green through
92d2eb74 on GitHub's runner, which HAS /etc/protocols) and INVISIBLE on any dev box.
Not s473u's.

Discriminating measurement: the row passes on the dev box and on the GitHub runner;
it fails only where `perl -e 'print scalar getprotobyname("tcp")'` prints nothing.

Fix shape (s337 ruling: getproto* = read /etc/protocols): when the file is absent the
built-in fallback must NOT answer -- undef / empty like perl -- OR the fallback is a
deliberate, documented divergence in docs/not-supported.md.  Either way the row needs
the container to be seen: tools/t/install-container.t runs the installer, not the gate;
a gate-in-container leg is where this would live (s478 ran one by hand:
`podman run â¦ localhost/pcl-install-base:<key> bash -c 'umask 022; â¦ tools/prove-core'`
as a non-root user -- NOTE umask 022, or PCL refuses the 0775 cache dir).  Cheap.
subject: getprotobyname/getprotobynumber answer from a BUILT-IN table when /etc/protocols is ABSENT; perl answers nothing there (found by running the gate in the stock ubuntu:24.04 install-matrix container, which ships no netbase)
